text:
maya (PM): quick sync — we need to pick the next set of models to onboard for Q2. multiple inbound asks (search, finops). can we decide sequencing + gating today?
liam (eng): short list i was thinking: Mistral-Instruct-8x, Llama-3-70B (8-bit), Omni-13B-fp16. ran a quick RICE sketch:
- Mistral: Reach=180, Impact=3, Confidence=0.7, Effort=6 -> RICE ≈ 63
- Llama3-70B: Reach=220, Impact=3.5, Confidence=0.5, Effort=12 -> RICE ≈ 32
- Omni-13B: Reach=120, Impact=2.5, Confidence=0.8, Effort=4 -> RICE ≈ 60
liam (eng): so by raw RICE Mistral > Omni > Llama3, but numbers are rough.
sana (ML): agree RICE helps, but we should prioritize by absolute regen quality on our evals and safety regressions too. propose gating:
- pass rate >= 95% on core prompt-suite (search relevance, instruction-following)
- hallucination delta <= +1.5% vs baseline
- token-cost delta <= 1.8x for hosted API (we can accept higher for Dedicated)
- p95 latency <= 400ms on our standard batch profile
sana (ML): Mistral-Instruct looks great on eval quality and cost. Llama3 gives higher reach for some customers but adds infra work for memory pressure.
alex (product ops): thinking about customer-driven asks: search team wants Llama3 for recall on enterprise docs; finops wants cheaper embeddings/generation (Mistral fits). maybe split sequencing by persona: onboard Mistral for Hosted first, then Llama3 as Dedicated/Private option.
maya (PM): scope negotiation: can we ship Mistral to Hosted with quantized 8-bit variant only, and hold full fp16 for Dedicated in later phase? that reduces effort now.
liam (eng): technically yes. plan: implement Mistral-8bit optimized kernel + canned quantization profile. effort estimate = 6 engineer-weeks (runtime + perf tuning). Llama3-70B will need 12 wks w/ memory plumbing and fallback work.
sana (ML): also recommend an eval gate we automate in CI: if post-quantization eval drops >2% on FAQ/LLM-safety set -> block rollout.
maya (PM): rollout plan suggestion: canary 1% traffic regionally -> 5% -> 25% -> full, with automated rollback if error-rate or latency crosses thresholds. A/B for search customers optional.
liam (eng): add automatic fallback policy to previous model variant and a capacity routing rule (if p95 latency > 750ms route to cheaper variant).
deploy-bot: scheduled: canary window for mistral-8bit on hosted set to start 1898860000; alert hooks: #incidents, pager if error_rate>0.5% for 15min.
alex (product ops): timeline / decision:
- phase 1 (2-3 weeks): onboard Mistral-Instruct-8x quantized to Hosted, gating via CI + automated rollback
- phase 2 (4-8 weeks): add Omni-13B for cost-sensitive customers (Dedicated opt-in)
- phase 3 (8-12 weeks): Llama3-70B onboarded to Dedicated/Private with memory work and customer pilot
maya (PM): decision check — anyone blocking?
sana (ML): no blockers if CI eval automation is scoped (i can own eval infra).
liam (eng): no blockers, will refine tickets and effort.
alex (product ops): i'll draft rollout playbook + customer comms for search and finops.
maya (PM): great — i'll convert this to a short spec and RICE appendix. thank you :tada:
